title: Texas 2026 Election Explorer
text:
Interactive Texas Map Explorer
Choose a tab below to divide Texas by County, U.S. Congressional District, State House District, or Voting Precinct. Every map adjusts to that geography level with 100% of Texas shaded in pastel blue (Democratic lead) or pastel red (Republican lead).

By County (254)By Congressional District (38)By State House District (150)By Region (7 Regions)By Voting Precinct


All 254 Texas counties colored by 2026 vote margin. Use the toggle in the top-right corner of the map to flip between Governor and U.S. Senate.








All 38 Texas U.S. House districts, shaded by the 2026 Congressional vote in each district (14 Democratic vs. 24 Republican seats).








All 150 Texas State Representative districts, shaded by each district’s 2026 State House contest (83 Democratic vs. 67 Republican districts). Zoom into DFW, Houston, Austin, or San Antonio to inspect urban legislative districts!








All 254 counties aggregated into 7 major Texas regions — comparing urban metro powerhouses (DFW, Greater Houston, Central Texas, Alamo / San Antonio, and South Texas & RGV) with East Texas and West Texas & Panhandle. Use the top-right toggle to switch between Governor and U.S. Senate.








Click any metro button below to zoom straight into neighborhood voting precincts across Texas’s 10 largest urban counties, backed by countywide results across all 254 counties so the entire state stays colored red or blue.

Jump to area: All Texas Houston & Fort Bend DFW (Dallas · Tarrant · Denton) Austin & Williamson San Antonio (Bexar) El Paso Rio Grande Valley (Hidalgo)











Sources: Texas Secretary of State 254-county November 2026 General Election returns (tx-sos/county-election-returns-2026) & OpenData 10-county precinct returns (opendata/tx-county-precinct-results-2026-general). Use the top navigation tabs (County Margins, Voting Methods, and Results Table) to explore detailed charts and county breakdowns.
